# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `make config-docs` from agent-manager-service/config/settings.go and the module manifests. Do not edit. -->

Agent Manager reads each setting from, first found:

1. the environment variable of its name (even an empty one, except for a generated secret);
2. `<NAME>_FILE` in the environment, a file holding the value;
3. `amp.yaml` (`--config`, else `$AMP_CONFIG`, else `./amp.yaml`), where the name is nested by `_`: `DB_HOST` is `db: {host: ...}`, and `<key>_file` names a file;
4. its older name, where it has one;
5. for a generated secret, its file in the secrets directory (`amp secret list`);
6. its default.

A value in `amp.yaml` can be a reference: `${env:NAME}` or `${file:/path}`, optionally with a default (`${env:NAME:-default}`). `amp init` and `amp serve` generate the secrets marked _generated_ on first run when nothing sets them, and keep them.

## Public URLs

| Setting | amp.yaml | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERVER_PUBLIC_URL` | `server.public_url` |  | Where browsers and clients reach the API and the console. Several defaults are worked out from it. Also read as `AMP_PUBLIC_URL`. |
| `THUNDER_BASE_URL` | `thunder.base_url` |  | ThunderID as browsers see it; the issuer of its tokens. Also read as `THUNDER_PUBLIC_URL`. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL` | `internal.server_public_url` |  | The origin module workloads reach the internal server at; empty means each request's own origin. |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN` | `cors.allowed_origin` | `http://localhost:3000` | Origin allowed to call the API from a browser (the dev console). |

## Server and ports

| Setting | amp.yaml | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERVER_HOST` | `server.host` |  | Address the API listens on; empty means all. |
| `SERVER_PORT` | `server.port` | `8080` | Port the API (and the console) listens on. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_HOST` | `internal.server_host` |  | Address the internal server (gateway and workload connections) listens on. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_PORT` | `internal.server_port` | `9243` | Port of the internal server. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_TLS_ENABLED` | `internal.server_tls_enabled` | `true` | Serve the internal server over TLS, with a certificate generated into INTERNAL_SERVER_CERT_DIR. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_CERT_DIR` | `internal.server_cert_dir` | `<data dir>/certs` | Where the internal server's certificate is kept. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `internal.server_read_timeout_seconds` | `10` | Internal server read timeout. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_WRITE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `internal.server_write_timeout_seconds` | `90` | Internal server write timeout. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `internal.server_idle_timeout_seconds` | `60` | Internal server idle timeout. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | `internal.server_max_header_bytes` | `65536` | Largest request header the internal server accepts. |
| `HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `http.read_timeout_seconds` | `10` | API read timeout. |
| `HTTP_WRITE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `http.write_timeout_seconds` | `90` | API write timeout. |
| `HTTP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `http.idle_timeout_seconds` | `60` | API idle timeout. |
| `HTTP_MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | `http.max_header_bytes` | `65536` | Largest request header the API accepts. |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `health.check_timeout_seconds` | `5` | How long /healthz waits on its checks. |
| `TLS_ENABLED` | `tls.enabled` | `false` | Read but not used by the server; the internal server has INTERNAL_SERVER_TLS_ENABLED. |

## Database

| Setting | amp.yaml | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DB_DRIVER` | `db.driver` | `sqlite, or postgres when DB_HOST is set` | sqlite or postgres. |
| `DB_PATH` | `db.path` | `<data dir>/agent-manager.db` | The SQLite file. |
| `DB_HOST` | `db.host` |  | PostgreSQL host. |
| `DB_PORT` | `db.port` | `5432` | PostgreSQL port. |
| `DB_USER` | `db.user` |  | PostgreSQL user. |
| `DB_PASSWORD` | `db.password` | `generated with postgres` | PostgreSQL password. **Secret.** |
| `DB_NAME` | `db.name` |  | PostgreSQL database. |
| `DB_SSL_MODE` | `db.ssl_mode` |  | PostgreSQL sslmode (disable, require, verify-full, ...); empty leaves the driver default. |
| `DB_SSL_ROOT_CERT` | `db.ssl_root_cert` |  | PostgreSQL sslrootcert: a CA bundle path, or "system". |
| `DB_MAX_IDLE_COUNT` | `db.max_idle_count` | `2` | Idle connections kept open; negative keeps none. |
| `DB_MAX_OPEN_COUNT` | `db.max_open_count` | `unlimited` | Most open connections. |
| `DB_MAX_IDLE_TIME_SECONDS` | `db.max_idle_time_seconds` |  | How long a connection may stay idle. |
| `DB_MAX_LIFETIME_SECONDS` | `db.max_lifetime_seconds` |  | How long a connection may be reused. |
| `DB_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `db.operation_timeout_seconds` | `10` | Timeout of one database operation. |
| `GORM_SKIP_DEFAULT_TRANSACTION` | `gorm.skip_default_transaction` | `true` | Skip the transaction GORM wraps single writes in. |
| `GORM_SLOW_THRESHOLD_MILLISECONDS` | `gorm.slow_threshold_milliseconds` | `200` | Queries slower than this are logged. |

| Setting | amp.yaml | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_MODE` | `auth.mode` | `idp` | How operators sign in: file (accounts in FILE_AUTH_USERS_PATH, the API issues tokens) or idp (ThunderID). |

| `FILE_AUTH_AUDIENCE` | `file.auth_audience` | `urn:wso2:amp` | Audience of file sign-in tokens. |
| `FILE_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL` | `file.auth_token_ttl` | `8h` | How long a file sign-in session lasts; it is not renewed. |
| `KEY_MANAGER_JWKS_URL` | `key.manager_jwks_url` | `the API's own keys (file), ThunderID's (idp)` | Key set the API validates sign-in tokens with. |
| `KEY_MANAGER_ISSUER` | `key.manager_issuer` | `Agent Management Platform Local and THUNDER_BASE_URL` | Accepted token issuers, comma-separated. |

| `AUTH_HEADER` | `auth.header` | `Authorization` | Header the API reads the bearer token from. |
| `OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_SERVERS` | `oauth.authorization_servers` | `THUNDER_BASE_URL` | Authorization servers the MCP endpoint advertises. |
| `OAUTH_SCOPES_SUPPORTED` | `oauth.scopes_supported` | `the scopes of the active modules` | Scopes the MCP endpoint advertises, comma-separated. |
| `JWT_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH` | `jwt.signing_private_key_path` | `<secrets dir>/jwt/private.pem` | Key agent tokens are signed with; generated on first start. **Secret.** |
| `JWT_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEYS_CONFIG` | `jwt.signing_public_keys_config` | `<secrets dir>/jwt/public-keys-config.json` | The public keys agent tokens are checked with. |
| `JWT_SIGNING_ACTIVE_KEY_ID` | `jwt.signing_active_key_id` | `key-1` | Key id of the signing key. |
| `JWT_SIGNING_DEFAULT_EXPIRY` | `jwt.signing_default_expiry` | `2160h` | Lifetime of an agent token. |
| `JWT_SIGNING_ISSUER` | `jwt.signing_issuer` | `agent-manager-service` | Issuer of agent tokens. |
| `JWT_SIGNING_DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT` | `jwt.signing_default_environment` | `default` | Environment an agent token names when none is given. |

## Secrets and state

| Setting | amp.yaml | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AMP_DATA_DIR` | `amp.data_dir` | `data (/var/lib/agent-manager in the image)` | Where state lives: the SQLite file, certificates and generated secrets. |
| `AMP_SECRETS_DIR` | `amp.secrets_dir` | `<data dir>/secrets` | Where generated secrets are kept; `amp secret list` names them. |
| `AMP_SHARED_SECRETS_DIR` | `amp.shared_secrets_dir` |  | amp init copies the secrets other containers read (the admin and PostgreSQL passwords) here, for a volume only those containers mount. |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | `encryption.key` | `generated on first start` | AES-256 key (64 hex characters) stored secrets are sealed with. Losing it makes them unreadable. **Secret.** |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS` | `encryption.key_previous` |  | Earlier keys, comma-separated, kept after a rotation so older secrets stay readable. **Secret.** |
| `SECRET_MANAGER_PROVIDER` | `secret.manager_provider` | `inhouse` | Where agent credentials are kept: inhouse (the database) or unsupported (refuses writes). |
| `SECRET_VAULT_PROVIDER` | `secret.vault_provider` | `local` | The vault that seals stored secrets. |
| `SECRET_VAULT_READERS` | `secret.vault_readers` |  | Other vaults kept for reading and cleanup, comma-separated. |
| `SECRET_VAULT_BIND_LOCAL_ROWS` | `secret.vault_bind_local_rows` | `false` | Bind each locally sealed secret to its row. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | `github.token` |  | GitHub token for repository API calls. **Secret.** |

## Module: ai-gateway

Set as `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_<KEY>`, or under `config:` in the module's `modules:` entry in `amp.yaml`:

```yaml
modules:
  - name: ai-gateway
    config:
      default_gateway_name: ...
```

| Key | Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default_gateway_name` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_NAME` |  | Registers a gateway with this name at startup, so a bundled gateway connects with no manual step; empty registers none. |
| `default_gateway_display_name` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_DISPLAY_NAME` | `Default AI Gateway` | The registered gateway's display name. |
| `default_gateway_vhost` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_VHOST` |  | The registered gateway's virtual host, the URL agents reach it at. |
| `default_gateway_type` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_TYPE` | `BOTH` | What the registered gateway handles: INGRESS, EGRESS or BOTH. |
| `default_gateway_org_ou_id` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_ORG_OU_ID` | `01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001` | The organization unit the registered gateway belongs to. |
| `default_gateway_token` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_TOKEN` |  | The registered gateway's registration token; generated and kept by amp init when unset. **Secret.** |
| `default_gateway_token_file` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE` |  | A file holding the registration token, read when DEFAULT_GATEWAY_TOKEN is unset. |
| `a2a_card_fetch_dial_addr` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_A2A_CARD_FETCH_DIAL_ADDR` |  | host:port every A2A agent card fetch dials instead of the card URL's host. |
| `manifest_cache_backend` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_BACKEND` | `memory` | Where deployment manifests are cached: memory or redis. |
| `manifest_cache_redis_host` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_REDIS_HOST` |  | Redis host for the manifest cache. |
| `manifest_cache_redis_port` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_REDIS_PORT` | `6379` | Redis port for the manifest cache. |
| `manifest_cache_redis_password` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD` |  | Redis password for the manifest cache. **Secret.** |
| `manifest_cache_redis_db` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_REDIS_DB` | `0` | Redis database number for the manifest cache. |
| `manifest_cache_redis_tls_enabled` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_MANIFEST_CACHE_REDIS_TLS_ENABLED` | `false` | Connect to Redis over TLS. |
| `websocket_max_connections` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_WEBSOCKET_MAX_CONNECTIONS` | `1000` | Most gateway connections the control plane accepts. |
| `websocket_connection_timeout` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_WEBSOCKET_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Seconds a gateway connection may stay silent before it is dropped. |
| `websocket_rate_limit_per_min` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_WEBSOCKET_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN` | `10` | Connection attempts one gateway may make per minute. |
| `deployment_timeout_sweep_interval_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEPLOYMENT_TIMEOUT_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `60` | How often deployments that never completed are looked for. |
| `deployment_timeout_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_DEPLOYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `300` | How long a deployment may stay in progress before it is marked failed. |
| `reconcile_render_interval_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_RECONCILE_RENDER_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `5` | How often due renders are claimed; a save also starts one. |
| `reconcile_place_interval_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_RECONCILE_PLACE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `600` | How often the fleet-wide placement pass runs. |
| `reconcile_drift_interval_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_RECONCILE_DRIFT_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `300` | How often deployed artifacts are checked for drift. |
| `reconcile_render_lease_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_RECONCILE_RENDER_LEASE_SECONDS` | `120` | How long a claimed render is held before another replica may claim it. |
| `reconcile_render_attempt_budget` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_RECONCILE_RENDER_ATTEMPT_BUDGET` | `30` | Failed renders that give up a deploy; waiting for an input never counts. |
| `failure_threshold_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_FAILURE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS` | `300` | A gateway disconnected for longer than this counts as failed. |
| `failure_max_age_seconds` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_FAILURE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | `604800` | A gateway disconnected for longer than this no longer counts as failed. |
| `failure_percentage_threshold` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_FAILURE_PERCENTAGE_THRESHOLD` | `10` | Percentage of failed gateways at which the fleet is reported unhealthy. |
| `agent_cors_allowed_origin` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_AGENT_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN` | `*` | CORS origins an agent's gateway route allows unless its settings say otherwise. |
| `agent_cors_allowed_methods` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_AGENT_CORS_ALLOWED_METHODS` | `GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,PATCH,OPTIONS` | CORS methods an agent's gateway route allows. |
| `agent_cors_allowed_headers` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_AGENT_CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS` | `authorization,Content-Type,Origin,X-API-Key` | CORS headers an agent's gateway route allows. |
| `agent_cors_allow_credentials` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_AGENT_CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS` | `false` | Whether an agent's gateway route allows credentials. |
| `controlplane_host` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_CONTROLPLANE_HOST` |  | amp init: host:port of Agent Manager's gateway listener, written into the gateway's config.toml. |
| `admin_password` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |  | amp init: the gateway's admin password; generated and kept when unset. **Secret.** |
| `amp_jwks_url` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_AMP_JWKS_URL` |  | amp init: Agent Manager's key set, which the gateway validates agent tokens with. |
| `thunder_issuer` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_THUNDER_ISSUER` |  | amp init: ThunderID's token issuer, as the gateway checks it. |
| `thunder_jwks_url` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_THUNDER_JWKS_URL` |  | amp init: ThunderID's key set URL, as the gateway dials it. |
| `host` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_HOST` |  | amp init: the gateway's public host name, for MCP auth metadata and its listener certificate. |
| `listener_port` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_LISTENER_PORT` | `19080` | amp init: the gateway's listener port. |
| `file_owner` | `MODULE_AI_GATEWAY_FILE_OWNER` |  | amp init: uid:gid the gateway's files are given. |
